buying_tips: Roots are often eaten skin-on, so how the grower raised them comes first.

Potatoes: firm, with no bruises, nicks, or soft spots.
Carrots: firm and well colored. With the tops on, choose bright green, fresh-looking tops.
Sweet potatoes: smooth and firm, even in shape and size, peel color even for the variety, free of damage.

Potatoes: a cool, dark, ventilated place, 45 to 50°F, for up to a month.
Carrots: a closed bag or container in the refrigerator, tops removed, up to two weeks. A wilted carrot revives in cold water.

label_cold_pressed_expeller.decision: Organic extra virgin olive oil or unrefined cold-pressed coconut oil.

label_sugar_free_substitutes.decision: USDA Organic unsweetened food with no sugar substitutes listed.

label_wild_vs_farm_raised.decision: Wild-caught fish with species, country and catch method named.

label_serving_size.decision: USDA Organic whole foods, panels compared at equal grams.

label_artificial_color.decision: USDA Organic food with no added coloring listed.

mercury_by_fish.decision: Sardines, anchovies, salmon and canned light tuna, small and short-lived.

canned_fish_choosing.decision: Fish in olive oil or water, bone-in and skin-on.

seafood_certifications.decision: Wild fish with a named origin and catch method.

canned_tuna.decision: Canned light tuna, or a can naming skipjack.

crab.decision: Live crab that moves, or cooked with bright orange-red shells.

smoked_salmon.decision: Wild-caught smoked salmon, nova or lox, kept cold.

seafood_counter.decision: Named species on ice, clean briny smell, springy flesh.

seafood_trout.decision: Whole wild trout, or rainbow trout from a spring-fed farm.

ground_beef_lean_ratio.decision: 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef with liver and heart ground in.

cheese_real_vs_processed.decision: Grass-fed raw cheese aged 60+ days, where legally sold.

raw_milk.decision: Grass-fed raw milk from a named farm, where legally sold.

butcher_counter_asking.decision: Ask the staffed counter for grass-finished beef, cut to order.

raw_kefir.decision: Plain grass-fed raw whole-milk kefir, where legally sold.

egg_duck_quail.decision: Pasture-raised duck or quail eggs, corn- and soy-free feed named.

turkey_bacon.decision: Pasture-raised turkey bacon, turkey named, no added sugar.

lamb_goat.decision: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished lamb or goat, farm named.

ghee.decision: Grass-fed ghee with butter as its only ingredient.

goat_sheep_dairy.decision: Grass-fed raw goat or sheep milk, where legally sold.

soy_milk.decision: Unsweetened soy milk of whole soybeans and water.

coconut_milk_beverage.decision: Unsweetened whole coconut milk of coconut and water.

deli_liverwurst_pate.decision: Pasture-raised liverwurst, with butter or named animal fat.

beef_grassfed_vs_grainfed.decision: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef, farm named.

beef_cuts_basics.decision: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef, in whole cuts.

turkey_whole.decision: Pasture-raised whole turkey with no basting solution.

bison.decision: 100% grass-fed, grass-finished bison from a named farm.

venison_game.decision: Grass-and-forage finished venison from a named farm.

poultry_duck.decision: Pasture-raised, soy-free whole duck with the skin on.

poultry_chicken_wings.decision: Pasture-raised chicken wings, air-chilled and uncoated.

rotisserie_chicken.decision: Pasture-raised rotisserie chicken, with salt and named herbs.

pork_cuts_and_enhanced.decision: Pasture-raised pork, farm named, with no added solution.

ground_turkey.decision: Pasture-raised ground turkey, breast and thigh meat only.

bacon.decision: Pasture-raised bacon, dry-cured with salt and wood-smoked.

chicken_breast.decision: Pasture-raised, air-chilled breast with bone and skin.

ham.decision: Pasture-raised whole-muscle ham, dry-cured with pork and salt.

cured_pork.decision: Pasture-raised whole pork cuts, dry-cured with salt.

grassfed_butter.decision: Grass-fed raw butter, where legally sold.

cream_vs_creamer.decision: Grass-fed cream, with cream alone on the list.

oat_milk.decision: Unsweetened oat milk made with oats and water.

sour_cream.decision: Grass-fed sour cream made with cream and cultures.

cream_cheese.decision: Plain grass-fed cream cheese made with live cultures.

cottage_cheese.decision: Grass-fed full-fat cottage cheese with cultured curds.

ice_cream.decision: Grass-fed ice cream of cream, milk, sugar and yolks.

almond_milk.decision: Unsweetened almond milk made with almonds and water.

egg_labels.decision: Soy-free, corn-free eggs from hens on pasture.

whole_vs_reduced_fat_milk.decision: Trusted raw milk from a farm, or low-temp pasteurized 100% grass-fed.

yogurt_plain_vs_flavored.decision: Plain Greek yogurt made from 100% grass-fed milk.

plain_kefir.decision: Plain kefir from 100% grass-fed whole milk.

raw_aged_cheese.decision: Aged raw milk or lait cru cheese, 60 days minimum.

dairy_case.decision: Choose the dairy type first, then read the carton.

breakfast_cereal.decision: Soaked, cooked oats; if boxed, organic soaked granola.

frozen_waffles.decision: Organic whole grain waffles, no dyes or enriched flour.

snack_bars.decision: Whole nuts, fruit, jerky or cheese ahead of any bar.

crackers.decision: Sourdough or sprouted organic crackers in olive oil or butter.

potato_chips.decision: Organic sliced potato chips in lard, coconut or olive oil.

frozen_nuggets.decision: Pasture-raised white meat nuggets, one solid piece.

frozen_fries.decision: Organic frozen fries in tallow, lard or coconut oil.

cooking_oils.decision: Olive or coconut oil, tallow, lard, butter or ghee.

salmon_wild_vs_farmed.decision: Wild salmon, frozen wild Alaskan before fresh farmed.

shrimp_imported_vs_domestic.decision: Wild American or Gulf shrimp; read the country of origin.

white_fish.decision: Wild-caught white fish by its named species, firm, mild-smelling.

scallops.decision: Dry or dry-packed scallops, with no phosphate or water listed.

lobster.decision: A live lobster that moves, or hard-frozen tails.
